# Add fastroll and gossamer teams

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

Adds two teams that appeared in [`davxy/jam-conformance`'s `scripts/targets.json`](https://github.com/davxy/jam-conformance/blob/main/scripts/targets.json) (GP 0.7.2) but were missing here. Both images verified pullable locally.

| Team | Image | Source | Mention |
|------|-------|--------|---------|
| fastroll | `ghcr.io/fastroll-jam/fastroll:latest` | [`fastroll-jam/fastroll`](https://github.com/fastroll-jam/fastroll) (public, Rust) | `@0xjunha` |
| gossamer | `ghcr.io/chainsafe/go-jam:latest` | [`ChainSafe/gossamer-jam-releases`](https://github.com/ChainSafe/gossamer-jam-releases) (public binary releases) | `@aang114` |

Per-team config decisions:
- **fastroll**: `readiness_pattern: 'listening on'` — its startup line is `JAM Fuzzer target server listening on /tmp/jam_target.sock`.
- **gossamer**: no explicit `readiness_pattern` — startup log has no clean "ready" marker, so the default socket-probe is used.
- Demo-full workflows: `docker_memory: '8192m'`, `num_blocks: 500` (per README full-spec guidance).

## Caveat

The actual source repo for the gossamer Docker image (`ChainSafe/go-jam`) is private. Only the binary releases repo is public. This is a slight tension with the `agents.md` checklist item "Source repo for the Docker image is public (for auditability)" — worth deciding whether to merge anyway or ask ChainSafe to open-source `go-jam` first.

## Test plan

- [ ] Trigger `Performance: fastroll` via `workflow_dispatch` and confirm minifuzz + picofuzz pass
- [ ] Trigger `Performance: gossamer` via `workflow_dispatch` and confirm minifuzz + picofuzz pass
- [ ] Trigger `Demo (tiny): fastroll` and `Demo (full): fastroll` via `workflow_dispatch`
- [ ] Trigger `Demo (tiny): gossamer` and `Demo (full): gossamer` via `workflow_dispatch`
- [ ] Verify both teams appear on the dashboard after the next deploy

## Walkthrough

This PR adds GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows for two JAM implementation teams: fastroll and gossamer. Each team receives demo workflows (tiny and full spec variants) and a performance test workflow, all delegating to existing reusable workflows. The README team status table is updated to document fastroll's workflow coverage.

## Changes

**CI/CD Workflow Infrastructure for JAM Teams**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Fastroll demo and performance workflows** <br> `.github/workflows/fastroll-demo-tiny.yml`, `.github/workflows/fastroll-demo-full.yml`, `.github/workflows/fastroll-performance.yml` | Three workflows added for fastroll: demo-tiny and demo-full invoke `demo-source.yml` with specs and fixed inputs (Docker image `ghcr.io/fastroll-jam/fastroll:latest`, readiness pattern `listening on`, mention `0xjunha`); performance invokes `reusable-picofuzz.yml` with the same image and readiness pattern. All trigger on daily cron, manual dispatch, and PR changes to the workflow files. |
| **Gossamer demo and performance workflows** <br> `.github/workflows/gossamer-demo-tiny.yml`, `.github/workflows/gossamer-demo-full.yml`, `.github/workflows/gossamer-performance.yml` | Three workflows added for gossamer: demo-tiny and demo-full invoke `demo-source.yml` with specs and inputs (Docker image `ghcr.io/chainsafe/go-jam:latest`, mention `aang114`, num_blocks `500` for full); performance invokes `reusable-picofuzz.yml` with the same image. All follow the same schedule/dispatch/PR trigger pattern as fastroll. |
| **README team status table update** <br> `README.md` | Fastroll team entry added to the status table with Performance and Demo (tiny/full) workflow badge links; Long-run unavailable. |
